name: GCM Securities Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1995, GCM Securities Ltd 
is in the business of Shares & Securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GCMSL is a SEBI registered Stockbroker with membership of both BSE and NSE. Apart from this, the company is in the business of carrying trading and investments in both Equity Shares and FNO Segment, broking, and other related activities of capital market. It also trades in Commodities market occasionally.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.08 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 271 to 63.9 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -20.9% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -10.4% over last 3 years.
